source_method: Read-only authorized owner billing-plan configuration cross-checked against membership checkout question-product mappings and Approved questionnaire metadata. No patient visit created, questionnaire answered, charge authorized, or independent post-intake quote obtained.
limitations: Configured billing prices are not a final card charge or independent consumer quote.
Tax, conditional visit/review fees, shipping overrides, discounts and final eligibility have not been tested.
Quarterly, SixMonth and Yearly are configured billing frequencies, not proof that a calendar-month supply is dispensed each month.
The 6- and 12-month cream/microdose mappings point to quarterly product variants; full term shipment quantities are not verified.
Pharmacies are owner-configured, not necessarily publicly named on the comparison source page.
